name: Commander Responsiveness Fixes
goal: Make the Commander responsive to the operator (remove the ~30-min idle-Brain restart, fix the dead threaded-reply path, operator fast lane, cut self-inflicted latency, de-dup alerts) and close the confirmed 48h-lookback guardrail gap plus the Task fan-out gap by registering shell-hook enforcement via a version-controlled Brain-settings sync — without weakening any guardrail.

tasks.name: R1: ping-probe instead of restarting an idle Brain
tasks.description: Fix needs_restart so the idle Brain is not restarted every ~30 min. Add self._ping_sent_at (float, init 0.0). In needs_restart, place the unanswered-ping check BEFORE the :947-949 _executing_tool short-circuit: if _ping_sent_at and _last_response_time < _ping_sent_at and now-_ping_sent_at > timeout_seconds -> restart. On 1800s idle (the old :950-960 condition) with no ping outstanding, send '[PING]' via send_message(:887) and set _ping_sent_at=now, return False. Reset _ping_sent_at=0.0 on any SDK message (:810) AND in restart()(:1012-1014) — the restart() reset is a restart-loop hazard (restart sets _last_response_time=0.0; a stale _ping_sent_at would fire the check immediately -> circuit breaker :991-998). Keep dead-thread(:932), tool-hang(:936-946), normal-timeout(:961-972). Add a [PING-ACK] rule to system_prompt.md (reply [PING-ACK], take no action); drop [PING-ACK] from _response_queue narration in poll_brain_responses (main.py). MUST NOT touch restart_daemon(orchestrator_mcp.py:6550) or the SIGHUP sequence. Ping cost (verified): the live ~/.ironclaude/brain/.claude/settings.json has NO Stop hooks (the brain-stop-hook/permission-seeker names live only in the unconsumed commander/hooks/brain-hooks.json), so a [PING] turn triggers no Stop-hook sweep. It DOES incur one permission-seeking LLM grade per ping (brain_client.py:849->618, on every Brain text incl. [PING-ACK]) — i.e. ~1 cheap grade / 30 min, vastly cheaper than the full restart+cache-rebuild it replaces. Acceptable; state it in the code comment. Do NOT add a ping-turn grade exemption (out of scope).

tasks.name: R5b: bound/keep-alive the operator-facing message grader
tasks.description: MEASURE FIRST then bound the local grader on the send_to_worker(:5779)/post_message(:6959) path so an empty-Ollama stall (up to 339s) can't hang the daemon path. The single shared _local_grader(:518) also serves :4431/:5253/:5881/:5936 — do NOT change its timeout globally. Add a second instance self._message_grader = LocalGrader(config_path=..., timeout=MESSAGE_GRADER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, keep_alive='30m') with a config key defaulting to 120 (conservative — NOT 60), used only by send_to_worker/post_message via a signature-compatible _call_local_grader(sp, up, schema, *, bounded=False) so the ~50 existing tools._call_local_grader MagicMock seams (e.g. :3510-3518 asserts on call_args.args[1]) keep working. Because the target grader's latency is not observable in daemon.log (it runs in the orchestrator MCP subprocess), default to keep_alive='30m' + the conservative 120s bound rather than a tight 60s (a 60s bound alone would cause false infrastructure_error -> Opus fallback on every cold model load). Keep the Opus escalation fallback. Do NOT touch GRADER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS(:469, the Codex/Opus subprocess constant).

steps.description: MEASURE (caveat): the send_to_worker/post_message grader runs in the ORCHESTRATOR MCP SUBPROCESS (brain_client.py:722-732; orchestrator_mcp.main() configures NO logging handler), so its latency is NOT in /tmp/ic/daemon.log — the empty-Ollama lines there are the DAEMON's OWN graders (_maybe_capture_operator_wait/_validate_brain_message/permission-seeking). This grep only CONFIRMS that empty-Ollama stalls occur in this environment; it does NOT measure the target grader. To choose bound-vs-keep_alive for the target, either add a temporary latency log line to the orchestrator grader path and observe, OR (preferred, default) treat cold model load as the dominant cause: set keep_alive='30m' AND a CONSERVATIVE bound (e.g. 120s, not 60s) so a genuine cold load does not trip a false infrastructure_error -> Opus fallback on every cold call.
steps.expected: a count (>0 confirms stalls occur in-env); NOT the target grader's latency — default to keep_alive='30m' + a conservative 120s bound unless a direct probe shows otherwise

Do not touch GRADER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS or the 15s test_grader fixture.

tasks.name: R5a: shell-hook gate on the Brain's Agent (subagent) fan-out
tasks.description: Cut the Brain wrapping gated actions in general-purpose subagents by a PreToolUse SHELL hook (the can_use_tool path is dead — see Task 8). Create commander/hooks/brain-task-gate.sh (structure modeled on worker/hooks/subagent-circuit-breaker.sh but DB-FREE) with matcher 'Agent|Task' — VERIFIED the daemon Brain (SDK BUNDLED CLI, ver 2.1.59) emits tool_name='Task' for subagent dispatch: 52 Brain transcripts in ~/.claude/projects/-Users-roberthyatt--ironclaude-brain/ contain "name":"Task", ZERO contain "name":"Agent"; subagent-circuit-breaker.sh:55's 'Agent' gate is the WORKER's newer PATH CLI (2.1.221), NOT the Brain. Match BOTH Task and Agent (future-proof against an SDK-bundle upgrade that flips the emitted name). Read .tool_input.subagent_type: allow only ironclaude:search-conversations; otherwise block_pretooluse (hook-logger.sh) with a message telling the Brain to act directly (fail-closed: an absent/empty subagent_type also blocks). The gate MUST be DB-FREE — do NOT copy subagent-circuit-breaker.sh's db_read_or_fail sessions lookup: a Brain session has no sessions row, so a DB read would DATABASE-ERROR-block every dispatch. Register it by adding its entry to commander/src/brain/brain_settings_hooks.json (matcher 'Agent|Task') — the Task-8 template-driven sync then deploys brain-task-gate.sh to ~/.claude/ironclaude-hooks/ and merges the entry into settings.json, so this task edits ONLY the template + the new script + system_prompt, NOT main.py. Keep/add the system_prompt.md rule: do not wrap gated actions in general-purpose subagents. Do NOT use SDK disallowed_tools (would block search-conversations too). Note: the Brain searches episodic memory via mcp__episodic-memory__ MCP tools directly (not the search-conversations subagent), so in practice this is close to a total subagent ban for the Brain — stricter, not weaker; the search-conversations allowance is a harmless safety valve.
